enumset-basics.title: EnumSet basics
enumset-basics.short: Store enum values in a specialized Set
enumset-basics.summary: Use EnumSet for compact sets of values from one enum type.
enumset-basics.why: EnumSet is designed specifically for enum constants and clearly expresses a set of flags or states from one enum.
enumset-basics.tips: Use EnumSet.noneOf or EnumSet.allOf when the set is built dynamically.

method-overloading-basics.title: Method overloading basics
method-overloading-basics.short: Use one method name with different parameter lists
method-overloading-basics.summary: Define related operations with distinct parameter signatures.
method-overloading-basics.why: Overloading lets callers use one meaningful operation name while the compiler selects an implementation from argument types.
method-overloading-basics.tips: Avoid overload sets that become ambiguous for null or implicit numeric conversions.

map-get-or-default.title: Read a Map value with a default
map-get-or-default.short: Use getOrDefault when a missing key has a natural fallback
map-get-or-default.summary: Return a fallback value without changing the Map.
map-get-or-default.why: getOrDefault keeps the common missing-key fallback case concise and does not insert the fallback into the map.
map-get-or-default.tips: If missing and explicitly mapped null must differ, check containsKey because getOrDefault follows Map lookup semantics.

string-repeat.title: Repeat a String
string-repeat.summary: Repeat a string a specified number of times.
string-repeat.why: String.repeat avoids manual loops when producing padding, separators, or other repeated text.
string-repeat.tips: The count must be non-negative and very large results still require corresponding memory.

class-not-found-exception.title: ClassNotFoundException
class-not-found-exception.short: A requested class could not be loaded by name
class-not-found-exception.summary: Handle failures from reflective class loading.
class-not-found-exception.why: APIs such as Class.forName can fail when the requested class is not visible to the active class loader or is absent.
class-not-found-exception.tips: Check the class name and runtime class path or module configuration rather than treating the exception as a compile-time missing-symbol error.

file-not-found-exception.title: FileNotFoundException
file-not-found-exception.short: A file could not be opened
file-not-found-exception.summary: Handle a missing or inaccessible file when opening a stream.
file-not-found-exception.why: FileInputStream reports FileNotFoundException when its target cannot be opened, including common missing-path cases.
file-not-found-exception.tips: Do not rely on a separate exists check for correctness because the file can change between checking and opening; handle the open failure too.

cyclic-inheritance.title: Cyclic inheritance
cyclic-inheritance.short: A class cannot inherit from itself in a cycle
cyclic-inheritance.summary: Remove inheritance cycles from the type hierarchy.
cyclic-inheritance.why: Java requires an acyclic class inheritance hierarchy, so a class cannot directly or indirectly be its own superclass.
cyclic-inheritance.tips: Check extends relationships across all involved classes and use composition when the model is not a true hierarchy.

break-outside-loop-switch.title: break outside a loop or switch
break-outside-loop-switch.short: Use break only where there is an enclosing breakable statement
break-outside-loop-switch.summary: Place break inside a loop or switch statement.
break-outside-loop-switch.why: An unlabeled break must have an enclosing loop or switch to terminate, otherwise the compiler has no valid target.
break-outside-loop-switch.tips: Use return to leave a method; do not add a dummy loop merely to make break legal.

unchecked-conversion-warning.title: Unchecked conversion warning
unchecked-conversion-warning.short: Do not assign a raw generic value to a parameterized type
unchecked-conversion-warning.summary: Preserve generic type information across assignments.
unchecked-conversion-warning.why: Converting a raw collection to a parameterized type cannot be fully checked by the compiler and can hide incompatible elements until runtime.
unchecked-conversion-warning.tips: Parameterize the source value and isolate unavoidable legacy raw-type boundaries.

array-equals-reference.title: Array equals compares identity
array-equals-reference.summary: Compare array contents with the Arrays utility methods.
array-equals-reference.why: Arrays inherit Object.equals, so two distinct arrays with equal elements are not equal through their equals method.
array-equals-reference.tips: Use Arrays.deepEquals for nested object arrays when recursive content comparison is intended.
